scope: Pinned terminfo.dev@4.0.0 erase-in-display termless criteria (erase.screen.below with ED 0, erase.screen.above with ED 1 and erase.screen.all with ED 2, all with the explicit parameter spelling) replayed byte-exactly on a disposable App and graded from parent-journaled readScreen stored cells, the cursor, stored attribute details and buffer state, with controls for the unmodified seed (no-op), every other ED spelling (omitted, explicit 0, 1 and 2: wrong direction, accidental whole-screen clearing), a full-screen fill control for unaffected rows and columns and the cursor-cell boundary, a boundary control with the cursor on the first or last column, a bold-seeded attribute control (retained attributes required; background-color erase observed, not required) and a main-screen history control (saved lines must survive: ED 2 is not ED 3). Stored state only: the pinned terminal pixel path is capture-only upstream and is not qualified; CSI 3J is not graded; no stock grades.
